title: Email result
sent: The email was accepted by the mail service and recorded by OneCrew.
replayed: OneCrew returned the previously recorded send result; no new email was sent.
batch_completed: The email batch completed: {accepted} accepted, {rejected} rejected.
batch_replayed: OneCrew returned the previously recorded batch result: {accepted} accepted, {rejected} rejected; no new emails were sent.
batch_unknown: The email batch finished with {unknown} uncertain, {accepted} accepted, and {rejected} rejected. Read the batch status with the same idempotency key before sending anything again.
